author: Riilo
body:
IGN: Riilo
Discord: Rilo#5735
Timezone: AEST
Why would you like to join the referee team?: I would like to join the referee team so I can involve myself more into the community. I have never really taken upon a staff rank on Avicus and I was really excited to see the applications for this. I have played currently 2 tournaments and many unofficial ones. I understand about my timezone isn't up to your standards, but I can work around that. 

Best time of the week?: The best time of the week for me to ref would probably be on the weekends. Considering I have to wake up/stay up at incredible times, I really wouldn't want to be sleep deprived on a school night.

A paragraph or two to tell us something about yourself: Hello, I am Rilo. I have been playing this server for over 3 years and have been an active regular for a year or 2 now. I am 14 years old and I am from Australia. I have applied for many of these kind of applications with no luck, so I was hoping this could be my chance. I am one of the most active players on this server; I am able to come on every single day. Obviously, I can play more on the weekends than weekdays. I want to be as involved as possible to this server as stated above, and hopefully I can be a ref for Avicus.
Anything else?: Not really...
